_note: V2 ground truth combines authenticated Snyk Code SARIF flows with manually curated stored API-to-React XSS and cross-file DNS diagnostic flows that Snyk does not currently emit.
description: Go and React SaaS application with attacker-controlled branding, authentication, health diagnostic, and media migration flows.

vulnerabilities.description: Owner-controlled htmlBody is persisted by the branding API, returned by the public custom-page API, and rendered through React dangerouslySetInnerHTML without the original DOMPurify sanitizer.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A tenant owner or administrator who can create a custom page can execute JavaScript in browsers that visit the published page.

vulnerabilities.description: The login continuation parameter flows from the document location directly to window.location.href after authentication (Snyk: javascript/OR).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted login link can redirect a user to an attacker-selected external site after sign-in.

vulnerabilities.description: The owner-only branding preview passes a request URL to an outbound HTTP client (Snyk: go/Ssrf).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An authenticated administrator can make the server fetch attacker-selected local or internal URLs.

vulnerabilities.description: The authenticated Admin → Health DNS diagnostic passes a request hostname from the handler into a shell command in the health domain helper. Snyk does not currently emit the cross-file flow.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Any root-tenant user with read-only admin access can execute additional shell commands in the server process.

vulnerabilities.description: The branding media migration download joins a request-controlled name to the media directory and reads the result (Snyk: go/PT).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An authenticated administrator can use relative path segments to read files outside the branding directory.
